tracksData.name: Stage 1: Hanmer Home Base to Mirabel (Pembroke -> Portage-du-Fort -> Route 148 -> Motel au P'tit Sapin)
Stage 2: Mirabel to Baie-Comeau Gateway (Route 158 -> Chemin du Roy Route 138 & Côte-de-Beaupré)
Stage 3: Baie-Comeau to Labrador City (QC-389 & Manic-5 Dam)
Stage 4: Labrador City to Happy Valley-Goose Bay (TLH 500 Central Taiga)
Stage 5: Happy Valley-Goose Bay to Blanc-Sablon / L'Anse-au-Clair (Direct TLH 510 Mainline)
Stage 6: Strait of Belle Isle Ferry to St. Anthony (Fishing Point Light) & Snorri Cabins (Hay Cove)
Stage 7: Full Viking Immersion Loop: Norstead 'Snorri' Knarr Ship & Cape Onion
Stage 8: The Viking Trail South to Gros Morne KOA (Point Riche Lighthouse)
Stage 9: The Tablelands (Earth's Mantle) & Green Point Coastal Ocean Camp
Stage 10: Codroy Valley (Cape Anguille & Cape Ray) to Marine Atlantic Overnight Ferry (Cabot Strait Crossing to North Sydney)
Stage 11: Cabot Trail Part 1: North Sydney 7 AM Jump to St. Ann's, Cape Smokey & Broad Cove Campground
Stage 12: Cabot Trail Part 2: Meat Cove Clifftop Spur to Chéticamp Campground
Stage 13: Canso Causeway & Confederation Bridge to PEI Grand Island Loop & Cavendish Beach
Stage 14: Cavendish to Confederation Bridge, Cape Enrage & Hopewell Rocks to Fundy NP Headquarters
Stage 15: Full Fundy Trail Parkway to Saint John & de la République Provincial Park (Edmundston, NB)
Stage 16: Edmundston, NB to Camping des Voltigeurs (Drummondville, QC - Direct Hwy 20 South Shore)
Stage 17: Drummondville to Best Western Pembroke Inn (A-30 Montreal Bypass)
Stage 18: Best Western Pembroke Inn to Hanmer Home Base (Saturday Homecoming!)

daysMeta.title: Hanmer, ON to Mirabel, QC
daysMeta.desc: Depart Hanmer eastward down the Upper Ottawa Valley along Highway 17 through North Bay and Petawawa to Pembroke. Cross the Ottawa River at Portage-du-Fort into Quebec, following scenic Route 148 along the river through Gatineau, Montebello, and Grenville to Lachute, then connecting via Route 158 to Mirabel for the evening.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 Commercial Motel: Motel au P'tit Sapin
daysMeta.fuel_desc: All major hubs (Sturgeon Falls, Pembroke, Shawville, Aylmer, Gatineau, Montebello, Mirabel) carry 91+ AKI.
highlights: Scenic ride along the Upper Ottawa Valley on Highway 17
Historic Chenaux Dam bridge crossing at Portage-du-Fort into Quebec
Tranquil river riding on Route 148 through Montebello, Grenville, and Lachute

daysMeta.title: Mirabel to Baie-Comeau, QC
daysMeta.desc: Depart Mirabel northeast via Route 158 through Saint-Jérôme and Joliette to Berthierville, joining the historic Chemin du Roy (Route 138) along the St. Lawrence River. Pass through Trois-Rivières and Quebec City to the Charlevoix coastal mountains on Route 362, cross the Saguenay Fjord via the Tadoussac ferry, and continue along the Côte-Nord to Baie-Comeau.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 Full-Service Hotel: Travelodge by Wyndham Baie-Comeau
daysMeta.fuel_desc: MANDATORY 100% TOP-OFF AT BAIE-COMEAU (Shell V-Power 91). Fill auxiliary fuel bladders before starting QC-389 tomorrow.
highlights: Historic Chemin du Roy (Route 138) along the St. Lawrence River
Charlevoix coastal mountain sweepers on Route 362 overlooking the estuary
15-minute marine ferry crossing across the mouth of the Saguenay Fjord into Tadoussac

daysMeta.title: Baie-Comeau, QC to Labrador City, NL
daysMeta.desc: Travel north on Quebec Route 389 through the boreal wilderness, passing the Manic-2 and Manic-5 hydroelectric dams and skirting the Manicouagan crater reservoir. Continue through the unpaved northern sector past the mining town of Fermont, crossing the provincial border into Labrador City for the night.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 Remote Wilderness Hotel: Hotel Wabush / Two Seasons Inn
daysMeta.fuel_desc: Manic-5 and Relais Gabriel carry 87 AKI only. Dose with chemical octane booster or transfer 91 from auxiliary bladder.
highlights: Daniel-Johnson Dam at Manic-5: world's largest multiple-arch buttress dam
Route 389 skirting the ancient Manicouagan meteorite impact crater
Fermont mining town and giant ore haulers at the Labrador border

daysMeta.title: Labrador City to Happy Valley-Goose Bay, NL
daysMeta.desc: Follow the Trans-Labrador Highway (Route 500) eastward across the central Labrador plateau, crossing the Churchill River at Churchill Falls. Proceed across paved taiga corridors with long sweeping turns through black spruce wilderness to Happy Valley-Goose Bay.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 Commercial Hotel: Royal Inn & Suites / Hotel North
daysMeta.fuel_desc: Churchill Falls is the only fuel stop in 532 km. 91 Premium can be limited; carry octane booster.
highlights: Pristine paved highway cruising through central Labrador black spruce taiga
Churchill Falls hydroelectric complex and river canyon crossing
Arrival in Happy Valley-Goose Bay, the historic subarctic aviation hub

daysMeta.title: Happy Valley-Goose Bay to L'Anse-au-Clair, NL
daysMeta.desc: Head south on the Trans-Labrador Highway (Route 510) through subarctic terrain past the Mealy Mountains. Refuel at Port Hope Simpson, visit the Red Bay UNESCO Basque Whaling Station on the coast, and reach L'Anse-au-Clair on the Strait of Belle Isle.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 Coastal Roadside Hotel: Northern Light Inn
daysMeta.fuel_desc: CRITICAL 405 KM FUEL DESERT to Port Hope Simpson. Siphon 91 Premium from lead tanker bladder at midpoint.
highlights: Trans-Labrador Route 510 through the remote Mealy Mountains subarctic corridor
Red Bay UNESCO World Heritage Site: 16th-century Basque whaling station
Point Amour Lighthouse: tallest lighthouse in Atlantic Canada (33 m)

daysMeta.title: L'Anse-au-Clair to St. Anthony & Hay Cove, NL
daysMeta.desc: Board the morning MV Qajaq W ferry from Blanc-Sablon to St. Barbe, Newfoundland. Ride north along the coastal Viking Trail (Route 430) to St. Anthony to visit the Grenfell Historic Properties and Fishing Point Lighthouse, then continue to Hay Cove near L'Anse aux Meadows.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 Oceanfront Turf-Roofed Cabins: Snorri Cabins / Valhalla Lodge
daysMeta.fuel_desc: St. Anthony has full 91 Premium pumps. Top off main tanks before heading into Hay Cove.
highlights: Strait of Belle Isle ferry crossing across Iceberg Alley on the MV Qajaq W
Fishing Point Lighthouse and ocean headland trails in St. Anthony
Authentic turf-roofed Norse cabin stay in Hay Cove overlooking the Atlantic ocean

daysMeta.title: Viking Cultural Loop: Norstead & Cape Onion, NL
daysMeta.desc: Spend the day exploring northern tip historical and coastal sites: tour the Norstead replica Viking village and the knarr ship Snorri, and ride to the coastal bluffs of Cape Onion before returning to Hay Cove for a second night.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 Oceanfront Turf-Roofed Cabins: Snorri Cabins / Valhalla Lodge (Night 2)
daysMeta.fuel_desc: Local gas available in Raleigh or St. Lunaire-Griquet. No fuel deficit on this short exploration day.
highlights: Norstead Viking Village and board the 54-ft replica merchant knarr ship Snorri
L'Anse aux Meadows UNESCO World Heritage Site: 11th-century Norse settlement
Rugged coastal bluffs and iceberg look-off at Cape Onion

daysMeta.title: Hay Cove to Gros Morne National Park, NL
daysMeta.desc: Travel south down the Great Northern Peninsula along Route 430, stopping at Point Riche Lighthouse in Port au Choix. Continue south into Gros Morne National Park to stay at the Gros Morne KOA in Norris Point for maintenance, laundry, and rest.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 Commercial KOA Campground: Gros Morne / Norris Point KOA Holiday
daysMeta.fuel_desc: Port au Choix, Daniel's Harbour, and Rocky Harbour offer reliable fuel stops every 80–120 km.
highlights: Coastal riding along the Gulf of St. Lawrence on Route 430
Point Riche Lighthouse and ancient limestone sea barrens in Port au Choix
Gros Morne KOA amenities: commercial laundry, hot showers, and gear refresh

daysMeta.title: The Tablelands & Bonne Bay, NL
daysMeta.desc: Explore the southern sector of Gros Morne National Park around Bonne Bay. Ride and hike the Tablelands to observe exposed earth mantle rock, visit Woody Point and Trout River, and camp oceanfront at Green Point Campground.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 National Park Oceanfront Campground: Green Point Campground (Gros Morne NP)
daysMeta.fuel_desc: Fuel up in Rocky Harbour before heading out to the Tablelands and Woody Point.
highlights: The Tablelands: rare barren landscape of exposed Earth's mantle pushed up by plate tectonics
Historic waterfront village of Woody Point and Woody Point Lighthouse
Seaside camping on coastal bluffs at Green Point Campground

daysMeta.title: Gros Morne to Port aux Basques Overnight Ferry
daysMeta.desc: Ride south through western Newfoundland and the Codroy Valley, visiting Cape Anguille and the transatlantic cable landfall at Cape Ray Lighthouse. Arrive in Port aux Basques in the evening to board the Marine Atlantic overnight ferry to North Sydney, sleeping in a private cabin stateroom.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 Overnight Ferry Private Stateroom: Marine Atlantic MV Highlanders / Blue Puttees
daysMeta.hotel_loc: Port aux Basques, NL to North Sydney, NS

highlights: Scenic ride through the emerald pastures of the Codroy Valley
Cape Anguille and Cape Ray historic coastal lighthouses
Overnight ferry crossing with private 2-berth en-suite stateroom cabin

daysMeta.title: North Sydney to Broad Cove (Cabot Trail East), NS
daysMeta.desc: Disembark the ferry at 07:00 AM in North Sydney and ride west to St. Ann's to begin the Cabot Trail. Climb over Cape Smokey to Neil's Harbour Lighthouse, then camp at Broad Cove Campground in Ingonish Beach.

highlights: Morning start onto the Cabot Trail along St. Ann's Bay
Cape Smokey coastal mountain hairpins and panoramic Atlantic look-offs
Neil's Harbour Lighthouse and oceanfront camping at Broad Cove

daysMeta.title: Broad Cove to Chéticamp (Meat Cove & Cabot Trail West), NS
daysMeta.surf_chip: 🛣️ Paved with Clifftop Spur (Cabot Trail West)

French Mountain coastal switchbacks descending to the Gulf of St. Lawrence
Skyline Trail boardwalk hike overlooking the Cabot Trail

daysMeta.title: Chéticamp, NS to Cavendish Beach, PEI
daysMeta.desc: Cross from Cape Breton over the Canso Causeway and ride northwest through Nova Scotia and New Brunswick to the Confederation Bridge. Cross onto Prince Edward Island to ride the coastal loop through Victoria-by-the-Sea, Cape Tryon Lighthouse, and Cavendish, camping at Cavendish Beach in Prince Edward Island National Park.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 National Park Oceanfront Campground: Cavendish Campground (PEI National Park)

highlights: Crossing the 12.9 km Confederation Bridge across Northumberland Strait onto PEI
Cape Tryon Lighthouse standing on 110-foot red sandstone ocean cliffs
Oceanfront camping at Cavendish Beach along red sand dunes

daysMeta.title: Cavendish Beach, PEI to Fundy National Park, NB
daysMeta.desc: Visit Seacow Head Lighthouse before crossing the Confederation Bridge back to New Brunswick. Follow coastal Route 915 to Cape Enrage Lighthouse, visit the sea stacks at Hopewell Rocks, and camp at Fundy National Park Headquarters in Alma.
daysMeta.hotel_title: 🏨 National Park Clifftop Campground: Fundy National Park Headquarters Campground

highlights: Seacow Head Lighthouse perched over red sandstone sea arches
Cape Enrage Lighthouse on 150-foot cliffs facing Bay of Fundy tides
Hopewell Rocks flowerpot sea stacks and oceanfront camping in Fundy National Park

daysMeta.title: Fundy National Park to Edmundston, NB
daysMeta.desc: Ride the 30 km Fundy Trail Parkway along the Bay of Fundy coast to St. Martins and Saint John, stopping at Reversing Falls Rapids. Continue north along Route 7 and Highway 2 through the Saint John River Valley, crossing the historic Hartland Covered Bridge to Edmundston.

highlights: Continuous coastal ride along the 30 km Fundy Trail Parkway
Saint John historic waterfront and Reversing Falls Rapids
Riding across the historic Hartland Covered Bridge (1901), the world's longest at 391 m

daysMeta.title: Edmundston, NB to Drummondville, QC
daysMeta.desc: Follow Highway 20 along the St. Lawrence South Shore through eastern Quebec past Rivière-du-Loup and Lévis. Arrive in Drummondville for the evening, camping along the Saint-François River at Camping des Voltigeurs.

Broad vistas of the St. Lawrence River along Highway 20
Riverside camping at Camping des Voltigeurs on the Saint-François River

daysMeta.title: Drummondville, QC to Pembroke, ON
daysMeta.desc: Take Autoroute 30 around Montreal and cross into Ontario on Highway 417. Follow Mitch Owens Road through rural southern Ottawa to Carleton Place, then take Highway 17 West past Renfrew to Pembroke for the night.

Rural highway riding through southern Ottawa agricultural landscapes
Hotel stay in Pembroke with indoor pool and restaurant

daysMeta.title: Pembroke, ON to Hanmer, ON
daysMeta.desc: Ride west along Highway 17 up the Ottawa River Valley through Petawawa, Deep River, and Mattawa. Pass through North Bay and continue west to complete the expedition loop at home in Hanmer.
